definition: Ballroom dance in three-four time. One-two-three, try to keep up.
A sudden, all-out attack or effort. See also: cleaning before guests arrive.
To confirm someone is honest or reliable. Would anyone vouch for that guess?
A distinct period in history or geology.
Four legs, a seat and a back. Not a dog, despite the legs.
Large orchestral work, usually in four movements. In 1933 Florence Price became the first Black woman to have a symphony played by a major US orchestra.
Large natural stream of fresh water flowing to the sea.
Ready to face danger or pain. Like starting with a Q.
Summer squash, also called a courgette. Double Z, double C, double trouble.
Rows of keys for typing or playing music. QWERTY was designed for typewriters, not for you.
A state of not knowing what to do. See also: choosing a Christmas present for your in-laws.
